property_summary: For any caller and any target/amount/data, if a non-owner calls sendMoney then the reference C preserves its balance (call does not transfer out funds to an external accepting contract), but the mutant (which removes onlyOwner) allows some non-owner calls to reduce C's balance when the target accepts value — so the reference's balance-after-call equals balance-before-call for all non-owners, while the mutant can make it decrease for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the ownership check from onlyOwner by making it a no-op, allowing non-owners to call sendMoney and thus changing observable state after sendMoney.
